actions: Release pressure and open the expansion tank cap
Close the drains and refit hoses
Re-check the level cold and after driving
Close the cap, refit covers, dispose of coolant
canonicalStep.title: expansion-tank-cap-and-vent-screw (BMW 328i draft Coolant Flush & Fill guide; evidence step 4, 9, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15)

elements.describe: The plastic coolant expansion tank with a screw-on filler cap and a filler neck carrying MIN and MAX level marks.
The screw cap on the expansion tank; turned slightly counter-clockwise first to release pressure, closed until it clicks.
A small M10 vent (bleeder) screw on the expansion tank, closed during venting and loosened only while filling.
MIN and MAX marks on the filler neck, plus a level indicator that one source calls a ball float.
